observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a used automotive engine assembly with a transmission bolted to it, sitting on a dirty workshop/yard floor.
Black plastic intake manifold cover has a hand-written/chalk marking that looks like 'AA2...' partially obscured, not a legible engine code or VIN.
A cardboard box labelled 'ATF W5' sits near the transmission, suggesting automatic transmission fluid was used or supplied.
Photo 1 shows a flex-plate/flywheel area with visible surface rust at the top right.
Wiring harness, injectors, hoses and sensors are attached and appear largely intact, consistent with a 'complete' pull.
No manufacturer plate, VIN sticker, engine-code stamp, or Lexus badge is visible in either photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON ... UCHENNA' is a seller/platform watermark, not identifying information about the engine.

identity.kind: used V6 engine assembly with attached transmission (seller claims fitment for Lexus IS250/GS250)

claims.claim: Complete engine for Lexus IS250 and GS250
claims.evidence: No VIN tag, engine code stamp, or Lexus badge visible in photo 0 or photo 1 to confirm make/model fitment.
Main block, manifold, harness and transmission are visible, but starter motor, alternator, turbo/sensors not clearly shown or counted in either photo.

risks.proof: Video of cold start-up with engine running and a compression test reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Rust visible on flex-plate (photo 1) could indicate water exposure or long outdoor storage affecting internals
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cylinder bores, oil pan underside, and inside the bell housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as having corrosion risk, lower than clean take-out

risks.risk: Engine and transmission may not be the originally matched pair from one donor car
risks.proof: Photo of VIN/engine number tag and transmission matched to the same donor vehicle paperwork

risks.risk: Mileage and donor vehicle history unknown
risks.proof: Odometer photo or donor vehicle registration/teardown photo

risks.risk: 'Complete' claim may exclude key ancillaries (starter, alternator, ECU, turbo if applicable)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all sides including front pulley end and rear bellhousing with all accessories attached

proof_requests: Clear photo of any VIN/engine number plate or stamped code on the block
Video of the engine running (cold start) to prove it is not 'for parts'
Close-up of the rusted flex-plate area and inside the bellhousing
Photos from all four sides showing starter, alternator, and turbo/sensors present
Any paperwork or donor-car photo linking engine and transmission as a matched set
response.reason: The item can be identified only generically as a used V6 engine-and-transmission assembly; no photo supports the specific Lexus IS250/GS250 fitment or that it runs, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, not-confirmed-running used engine pending the listed proofs.
